summary: Apply AI to utility forecasting, asset maintenance and grid decisions. Assess data readiness and shape a practical pilot. Explore the course.
lede: AI in electricity utility operations uses operational data to support demand and renewable-generation forecasts, maintenance priorities and grid decisions. For utility engineers, operations planners, renewable-energy operators and energy data analysts, the course develops practical skills in checking SCADA, AMI and asset-record readiness, comparing forecast errors, and shaping maintenance or grid decision-support workflows. It also covers model limitations, monitoring and points for human review.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who work with utility operations, renewable generation, grid planning or energy-sector analytics and need to evaluate realistic AI applications.
modules: Utility AI Risk and Model Review
prerequisites: Working familiarity with electricity utility operations, renewable-energy operations, asset maintenance or energy-sector data is expected. No programming experience is required; exercises use supplied sample datasets and spreadsheet-based analysis.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
